definition: The practice of including a shared portion of text between consecutive chunks when splitting a document, to avoid losing context at chunk boundaries.
details: Chunk overlap helps prevent important information that spans a chunk boundary from being fragmented in a way that hurts retrieval or comprehension.
story: Imagine explaining a hard concept to a friend using nothing but a napkin and a pen. Boil it down and it is this: The practice of including a shared portion of text between consecutive chunks when splitting a document, to avoid losing context at chunk boundaries. Here is why it matters: Chunk overlap helps prevent important information that spans a chunk boundary from being fragmented in a way that hurts retrieval or comprehension. A small mental model that makes a big tangle suddenly simple. And that idea, made concrete, is Overlap (in chunking).
